about: The shared memory Local\PTRCraft_v1 (magic PTRC, SkyCraft protocol v11 layout): one row per channel. PTR creates the mapping; Minecraft opens it. Offsets match research/skycraft_protocol.h, ptr-plugin/src/Proto.cs and minecraft/.../link/Proto.java.

columns.verified: Evidence from a real run, or 'no'

rows.carries: magic, version, both pids, both heartbeats

rows.carries: in level / menu / loading, who draws Minecraft's world (SkyHostDrawsWorld), level id, collision epoch, spawn feet, look yaw/pitch, teleport seq, overlay size; at +0x40 the level's key (its Minecraft world) and at +0x70 its name
Minecraft player feet, eye, look, FOV, flags (on ground, sneaking, screen open, dead)
